edit.statement: Heating a rubber band that is stretched under a constant load lowers its length: it contracts.
edit.subject: Heating a rubber band stretched under a constant load

notes: Real: the Gough-Joule effect (Gough 1802, Joule 1850s): elastomers under tension contract when heated (Wikipedia 'Gough-Joule effect'). It runs against ordinary thermal expansion, so models often get it wrong.
